thread:
maya: Quick eyeballs please — noticed filter chips in the model catalog lose their outline when focused with keyboard. Hard to see where focus is. https://figma.com/file/abc123 :eyes:
jonah: I saw that too. On dark mode it's especially subtle. Can we keep a 2px contrast ring? Figma link looks slightly different though.
alex: Repro steps? I couldn't on my end.
maya: Steps: open Catalog > Filters > Tab through chips. On Chrome Mac with high-contrast off, focus ring is nearly invisible. Screenshot: https://i.imgur.com/visibility.png
priya: This might be an a11y fail — WCAG requires focus visible. Suggest `outline: 3px solid var(--focus)` or `box-shadow` with high-contrast fallback. Also aria attributes: the chips should have `role="button"` and `aria-pressed` when pinned.
alex: Agree on aria. Right now chips are plain spans with click handler. I'll swap to `<button>` and add `aria-pressed`.
jonah: For the visual, let's use `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(16,124,255,0.35)` — matches our brand and keeps contrast.
maya: Copy nit too: in filter rail header it says "Filter models". Can we change to "Filter models & versions" when version pinning is enabled? Users miss that you can pin versions inside the catalog.
alex: Where would that copy live? I can make it dynamic based on whether any model has a pinned version in the current view.
maya: Yes, dynamic. If pinned var present show "Filter models & versions"; else keep original.
priya: Keyboard order: after closing a dropdown, focus should return to the controlling chip. Right now it jumps to top of list.
alex: Good catch. I'll implement focus return with `menuButton.focus()` in the close handler. Tests will be added.
designbot: Reminder: please update the component docs in /components/filter-chips.md and add an example for keyboard nav. :memo:
maya: For badges (perf / cost badges) — spacing between badge and title tight on mobile. Can we add 6px horizontal gap?
jonah: I'll mock that in Figma and post an artboard. Quick poll: gap 6px vs 8px? :thinking_face:
alex: 6px works better at small breakpoints.
maya: Action items: alex implement semantic buttons + focus styles, jonah update Figma + copy for version pinning, priya verify with Lighthouse, maya will follow up on docs. Target PR by EOD Friday. :calendar:
priya: I'll run axe-linter on the diff once PR ready. :white_check_mark:
alex: On it. Posting branch when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/compare/fix/filter-a11y
maya: Thanks team! :thumbsup:
